libraries.name: OpenJDK
libraries.description: The Java runtime that patching runs in, built for Linux by BellSoft (Liberica). Its source is at https://github.com/openjdk/jdk25u and https://github.com/bell-sw/Liberica

libraries.name: GNU C Library
libraries.description: The C library the Java runtime runs on, as termux-pacman builds it for Android. Its source is at https://sourceware.org/glibc and https://github.com/termux-pacman/glibc-packages

libraries.name: zlib
libraries.description: The compression library the Java runtime links against, as termux-pacman builds it. Its source is at https://github.com/termux-pacman/glibc-packages

libraries.name: GCC runtime library
libraries.description: libgcc_s, which that zlib links against, as termux-pacman builds it. Its source is at https://gcc.gnu.org and https://github.com/termux-pacman/glibc-packages
